comment.body: Thanks for identifying Microsoft Terminal and Visual Studio as affected while desktop/other apps work, and for the follow-up that the symptom persists. The report lists PowerToys 0.92.1, so please confirm the version you use now and whether the same double-Control sequence still fails in both apps. If it does, please say whether either app is running as administrator. This distinguishes a current foreground-app/elevation interaction from an old-version issue.

proposed_fixes.root_cause: A foreground-app interaction may prevent the double-Control activation from being recognized, but the cause could be hook delivery, app privilege or another setting; no mechanism is established.

confidence.rationale: The report supports a possible bug but is old and does not identify a mechanism; current-version confirmation changes whether implementation is justified.

plan: Confirm current-version reproduction with double-Control in the two named apps and a desktop control.
